pages.title: Meridian Bookkeeping & Advisory
pages.description: Manchester bookkeepers and accountants for small businesses. Bookkeeping, payroll, VAT and year-end accounts, handled properly so you can focus on trading.

blocks.heading: Clean books, fewer surprises, more time to run your business
blocks.subheading: We handle the bookkeeping, payroll and VAT for growing UK small businesses — accurately, on time, and explained in plain English.
blocks.mediaAlt: Bright shared workspace with desks and meeting areas

blocks.heading: Numbers you can actually trust
body: Most small business owners don't lie awake worrying about debits and credits — they worry about cash, tax bills and whether the figures they're looking at are right. That's exactly the worry we take off your plate.
Meridian keeps your records tidy month to month, so there are no nasty January surprises and every decision you make is based on real, up-to-date numbers.

blocks.heading: Everything your business needs to stay compliant
blocks.intro: Pick the pieces you need, or hand us the lot. Fixed monthly fees — no surprise invoices.

items.title: Bookkeeping
items.description: Day-to-day records kept current with cloud software, bank feeds reconciled weekly so you always know where you stand.

items.title: Payroll
items.description: Accurate PAYE, pensions auto-enrolment and payslips run on schedule, with RTI submissions to HMRC handled for you.

items.title: VAT & tax returns
items.description: VAT returns prepared and filed under Making Tax Digital, plus Self Assessment and corporation tax when they fall due.

items.title: Management accounts
items.description: Monthly or quarterly reports that show profit, cash and trends clearly — so you can plan, not just look back.

items.title: Company formation
items.description: New company set up correctly from day one: incorporation, HMRC registrations and a sensible chart of accounts.

items.title: Advisory
items.description: A real person to call about pricing, hiring, or a big purchase — practical advice from someone who knows your numbers.

blocks.heading: A bookkeeper who picks up the phone
body: You get a named contact who knows your business — not a call centre and not a different face every quarter. We reply within one working day, and we explain things without the jargon.
We work with Xero and QuickBooks, we're AAT-licensed and fully insured, and our fees are fixed and agreed up front so you can budget with confidence.

items.question: Do I need to switch accounting software?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We work with Xero and QuickBooks and can review whatever you use today. If a change would genuinely save you time or money we'll say so and handle the migration — otherwise we'll happily work with your current setup.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every business is different, so we quote a fixed monthly fee based on transaction volume and the services you need. You'll always know the price before we start, and there are no charges for a quick phone call or email.

items.question: Can you take over from my current bookkeeper?
items.answer: Yes. Switching is straightforward — we handle the handover, get access to your records and software, and make sure nothing is missed. Most clients are fully moved across within a couple of weeks.

items.question: Are you registered and insured?
items.answer: We're licensed by the AAT, registered for anti-money-laundering supervision, and carry professional indemnity insurance. We're also registered as HMRC agents so we can deal with them on your behalf.

blocks.heading: Ready to hand off the books?
blocks.body: Tell us a little about your business and we'll send a fixed-fee quote within one working day.

blocks.heading: How we work
body: We start with a short call to understand your business and how it runs today. From there we agree a fixed monthly fee and a simple checklist of what we need from you each period.
Everything lives in the cloud, so you and your team can raise invoices and snap receipts on your phone while we take care of the reconciliations, filings and reporting behind the scenes.

blocks.heading: Not sure which services you need?
blocks.body: Book a free 20-minute call and we'll point you in the right direction — no pressure, no jargon.

pages.title: About
pages.description: Meridian Bookkeeping & Advisory is a Manchester bookkeeping practice helping small businesses stay on top of their numbers.

blocks.heading: A small practice that treats your business like our own
blocks.subheading: We're a Manchester-based bookkeeping and advisory practice working with tradespeople, agencies and independent shops across the North West.

blocks.heading: Our story
body: Meridian started in 2016 with a simple frustration: too many small businesses were getting their accounts back months late, riddled with jargon and impossible to act on. We thought bookkeeping should be timely, clear and genuinely useful.

Today we look after the books for more than a hundred local businesses. We've grown by referral, because clients tell their friends that for once the numbers make sense — and someone actually answers the phone.

blocks.heading: What we value
body: Clarity over jargon. Every report and email is written so you can act on it, not so it sounds clever.
On time, every time. Deadlines are the whole point of a bookkeeper — we don't miss them.
Fixed, fair fees. You'll never get an invoice for a phone call or a quick question.

blocks.heading: Like the sound of us?
blocks.body: We'd love to hear about your business. Get in touch for a friendly, no-obligation chat.
